mcqs.question: Which of the following statements correctly defines average power?

options.A: Average power is the total work done divided by the total time taken.
options.B: Average power is the instantaneous rate at which work is done at a particular moment.
options.C: Average power is the product of force and displacement.
options.D: Average power is the work done per unit distance.

mcqs.answer: Average power is the total work done divided by the total time taken.
mcqs.explanation: Average power (P_avg) is defined as the total work (W) performed divided by the total time interval (Δt) over which the work is done, i.e., P_avg = W/Δt. Option B describes instantaneous power, while C and D are unrelated definitions.

mcqs.question: A constant force of 10 N acts on a particle that at a particular instant is moving with a velocity of 5 m/s in the direction of the force. What is the instantaneous power delivered to the particle at that instant?
mcqs.explanation: Instantaneous power is given by P = F·v (dot product). Here F = 10 N and v = 5 m/s in the same direction, so P = 10 × 5 = 50 W. Option A would correspond to 10×2, option C to 10×10, and option D would be correct only if the force were perpendicular to the velocity.

mcqs.question: A worker does 200 J of work in 4 s. What is the power delivered by the worker?
mcqs.explanation: Power = Work / Time = 200 J / 4 s = 50 W. The other options result from incorrect division.

mcqs.learning_point: Relate power to force and velocity
mcqs.question: Which expression correctly relates mechanical power to the applied force and the instantaneous velocity of the point of application?
mcqs.explanation: Mechanical power is the scalar product of force and velocity: P = \(\vec{F}\cdot\vec{v}\) = Fv when they are collinear. Option A mixes force with acceleration, B inverts the relation, and D mixes mass with velocity.

mcqs.question: Average power is:

options.A: The rate at which work is done at a specific instant.
options.B: The total work done divided by the total time taken.
options.C: The force applied multiplied by the distance moved.
options.D: The energy transferred per unit mass.

mcqs.answer: The total work done divided by the total time taken.
mcqs.explanation: Average power (P_avg) = total work (W) / total time (Δt). Option A describes instantaneous power, C describes work, and D is unrelated to power.

mcqs.question: A car engine delivers an instantaneous power of 30 kW when the car is moving at 15 m/s. What is the instantaneous force exerted by the engine on the car at that moment?
mcqs.explanation: Instantaneous power P = F·v ⇒ F = P/v. Here P = 30,000 W and v = 15 m/s, so F = 30,000 / 15 = 2000 N. The other options arise from incorrect division or multiplication.

mcqs.question: A person lifts a 20 kg box vertically through a height of 2 m in 4 s. Assuming g = 9.8 m/s², what is the average power expended during the lift?
mcqs.explanation: Work done = mgh = 20 × 9.8 × 2 = 392 J. Power = Work / Time = 392 J / 4 s = 98 W. Option A is half, C is double, D is the work value not divided by time.

mcqs.learning_point: Relate power to force and velocity
mcqs.question: A conveyor belt moves at a constant speed of 3 m/s. If the motor driving the belt supplies a mechanical power of 1500 W, what is the magnitude of the net force that the motor must exert on the belt?
mcqs.explanation: Using P = F·v, we get F = P/v = 1500 W / 3 m/s = 500 N. The other options correspond to incorrect division (e.g., using 6 m/s) or multiplication.
